title: National Action Programme To Combat Desertification
definition: The National Action Programme (NAP) is India's strategic policy framework formulated to implement the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD), aimed at addressing land degradation and desertification through sustainable land management and community-based interventions.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Environment & Ecology) and GS Paper I (Geography). Frequently linked to Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 15.3) and India's commitment to Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Action Programme To Combat Desertification.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
